name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio: Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport catering was a happy accident. After years of running a successful brasserie in Brussels, he was approached by a local racing team struggling with consistent, high-quality meals for their staff. Jean-Pierre stepped in, bringing his restaurant expertise to the paddock. He believes that a well-fed team is a successful team, and his approach is to provide familiar, comforting food with a touch of Belgian flair. He's known for his meticulous planning and insistence on using the freshest, locally sourced ingredients, no matter where the race is held. He's currently looking to bring his skills to a larger team, hoping to make a name for himself.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back, receding hairline
physical.description: Jean-Pierre is of medium build with a slightly weathered face, hinting at his years in the kitchen.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with menu ideas.
Insists on personally tasting every dish before it's served.
Has a habit of humming classical music while prepping food.
